description: Fields set by environment variables are ignored. The change is applied before it is saved: nginx -t runs on the new core config and nginx is reloaded; when applying fails, nothing is saved.

worker_processes.description: Worker processes: auto or a number from 1 to cpu_count (env NGINX_WORKER_PROCESSES)

worker_shutdown_timeout.description: How long an old worker may finish its connections after a reload: 0 or an nginx time such as 1h or 30s (env NGINX_WORKER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT)

log_not_found.description: Log requests for missing files in the error log (env NGINX_LOG_NOT_FOUND)

tls12.description: Allow TLS 1.2 besides TLS 1.3 (env NGINX_DISABLE_TLS12, inverted); off while force_mlkem is on

force_mlkem.description: Only offer the post-quantum key exchange X25519MLKEM768, which turns TLS 1.2 and the NIST P curves off (env NGINX_FORCE_X25519MLKEM768)

secp_curves.description: Trust the NIST P (secp) curves (env NGINX_TRUST_SECPR1); off while force_mlkem is on

rsa_pkcs1.description: Allow RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signatures (env NGINX_TRUST_RSA_PKCS1)

module_ldap.description: Load the LDAP auth module (env NGINX_LOAD_LDAP_MODULE)

module_vts.description: Load the virtual host traffic status module (env NGINX_LOAD_VHOST_TRAFFIC_STATUS_MODULE)
